rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a spherical model of Earth used for study or display.

example.english: I used to look at maps on a globe all the time when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個成日對住個地球儀睇地圖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 go3 dei6 kau4 ji4 tai2 dei6 tou4

rows.note: Use this for the covering or shade around a lamp, especially when referring to its glass or protective globe.

example.english: This globe is cracked, so let's replace it with a new one.
example.traditional: 呢個燈罩裂咗，不如換個新嘅啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dang1 zaau3 lit6 zo2 bat1 jyu4 wun6 go3 san1 ge3 laa1
